about_the_game:
Empower Your Intent is an atmospheric rhythm game that helps build mindfulness and intentionality while consuming entertaining software. Researched and designed to enhance your mental state while avoiding addictive patterns.

Mesmerizing projectiles are choreographed to the rhythms and melodies of the music. Focus the timing and direction of your sparks to burst the projectiles into an eruption of flower petals.  

Potential Uses:

  • A healthier alternative to ease cravings for highly-addictive software like social-media and other games. 

  • A ritual to boost motivation and productivity before starting a bout of focused work.

  • Relax: in general or to prepare for sleep. 

  • Energize and train reflexes/ coordination. 

  • Introduce gaming to those seeking to train new skills. (Has accessibility features so that people with no prior gaming experience can enjoy)

  • Obviously you can just use it to have fun and enjoy the music too :p
